show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Peter Kraus - Widening the Aperture on Alpha (First Meeting, EP.14)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Historically, these businesses were built
on the basis of asset growth. So your job is sort of the manager of that business was
to create a stable platform and produce returns that were solid, but have enough
options that you could take advantage of the asset growth.
